name: Wizard's Tower (Inside)
subtitle: Filled with magical artifacts and ancient tomes.

props.note: Writing stool, in the central right part of the room, beside the book-filled magical study. Choose sit here to settle into this seat.

description: The wizard's tower interior is a crowded, warmly lit study beneath heavy timber beams. A round worktable in the centre carries open books, loose papers, bottles and a violet crystal sphere. More books and glassware fill the shelves and side tables around the walls. A stone fireplace burns on the upper right, and a spiral stair curves upwards on the left. Candles, wall flames and luminous butterfly shapes brighten the room; scattered parchment sheets spill across the plank floor around the central table. The familiar hearth and wood sit alongside coloured potions and arcane objects, making this a working magical study rather than an empty tower chamber.
